descriptionHtml:
8-week four-day upper/lower split alternating power work and hypertrophy volume.

Structure: 8 weeks, 4 scheduled sessions per week, 40+ referenced exercise ids.

Weekly split: Upper Power, Lower Power, Upper Hypertrophy, and Lower Hypertrophy.

  • Goal: strength and hypertrophy
  • Level: intermediate
  • Duration: 8 weeks
  • Tags: PHUL, upper lower, powerbuilding, and 4 days per week
